messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off the security baseline for the new eu3-gpu cluster. Goal: IAM roles, secrets, KMS/HSM integration, policy checks, and a short pre-handoff runbook.

sam: Thanks. Is there an existing checklist we can reuse? cc: @leo @tara

leo: I have a compact gating list — posting it inline so we can iterate.
- dedicated instance profile: role/ri-eu3-node (no broad EC2 permissions)
- controller-manager + kube-system service accounts least-priv
- all secrets stored in Vault; transit encryption with KMS CMK
- KMS key policy must include org-admins + infra-ci role, no wildcard principals
- HSM only for prod CMKs, request via security oncall with attestation
- restrict egress, use private GCR/ECR mirrors and VPC endpoints for S3/KMS/Vault
- terraform plan + automated `policy-lint` must pass before handoff

maya: Nice. Can you paste the minimal Terraform snippet for creating a CMK with the right policy?

leo: ```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "eu3_cluster" {
  description             = "EU3 cluster CMK (for Vault transit)"
  key_usage               = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
  policy                  = data.aws_iam_policy_document.kms_policy.json
}

resource "aws_kms_alias" "eu3_alias" {
  name          = "alias/ri-eu3-cluster"
  target_key_id = aws_kms_key.eu3_cluster.key_id
}
```

tara: Quick finance note: if we opt for CloudHSM-backed keys the monthly cost per HSM cluster is significant (~$1k+/month depending on region). I'll open a finance ticket for approval if we need HSM for eu3. Also need manual rotation procedure documented.

ian: For IAM role assumptions, add conditions: aws:SourceAccount, aws:SourceArn and require MFA where possible. Also prefer explicit resource ARNs in policies rather than wildcards.

infra-bot: automated policy scan on branch feature/eu3-security returned 2 warnings: missing KMS alias and a publicly open S3 bucket policy. Run `./tools/policy-lint` for details.

sam: Let's define gating tests: 1) terraform plan (no policy diffs) 2) policy-lint passes 3) Vault secrets created and encrypted with CMK 4) KMS alias exists 5) node role least-priv verified 6) network egress tests pass

maya: Add a manual step: HSM approval via security-oncall and verify HSM attestation + CSP conformance docs before switching production keys to HSM.

leo: Quick validation commands I use during bring-up:
```bash
# verify kms alias exists
aws kms list-aliases --query "Aliases[?AliasName=='alias/ri-eu3-cluster']"

# run policy linter for infra changes
./tools/policy-lint infra/eu3 || true

# inspect node instance profile
aws iam get-role --role-name ri-eu3-node | jq '.Role.AssumeRolePolicyDocument'
```

tara: Also ensure KMS key rotation schedule is configured and CloudTrail is logging kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt to a secure bucket with proper retention + restricted access. Add that as mandatory for production.

maya: Who's owning the operational handoff? Need an owner and a pager for the first 72h after bring-up.

sam: I'll own the first 72h post-launch and create the PagerDuty schedule entry. I'll run the preflight checks and respond to any alerts.

leo: I'll convert this thread into a short runbook checklist and raise a PR with terraform + validation scripts: https://git.company/repo/pull/1234 (will include all commands and policy-lint hooks).

infra-bot: deploy-bot reports that p4d instance types requested for eu3 are not available in the region; planning fallback to g5-family. Please confirm capacity requirement and update the cost estimates in the PR.

tara: Cost note: g5 multi-az configuration is roughly ~30% cheaper than p4d in our pricing, but perf delta may be material. I added a cost delta section to the PR and flagged for perf benchmarking.

maya: Next steps: leo to push runbook PR, sam to run preflight checks, tara to open finance approval for HSM if we choose that route. I'll schedule a security handoff meeting tomorrow 10:00 CET and include oncall. :thumbsup:

sam: Sounds good. I'll post the preflight run results in this thread once complete.

leo: ack. I'll also add a quick `post-check` script that verifies Vault is using the correct key and that KMS alias points to the intended key id.

infra-bot: note: created ticket INFRA-4521 for region capacity verification and linked to PR.

maya: Thanks everyone — this is shaping up into a solid baseline. We'll iterate on the PR and lock gating tests before handoff. :white_check_mark:
